direction: Explore new priority rules for the CVRP greedy construction.
hypothesis: A different distance/load combination yields better routes.

operations.mechanism: Try a different combination of distance, depot distance and load.

preserve: The problem interface, the evaluator and the search policy.

research_activity.decision_summary: Invariance alone keeps losing at nominal scale (cheapest invariant 11.5050 vs 10.9197). Change the mechanism that chooses the tie-break value, not only the width: keep the nominal score within 1% of the reference and let the second stage act only where primary scores fall inside a relative band.
research_activity.finding_summary: Round 3: 7 of 7 distinct candidates feasible. Best nominal 11.5050 (+5.36% vs frozen reference 10.9197); re-expressing the same instances at 1e-3 moves it by +0.00%. 7 candidate(s) held the spread under 1%, 0 reproduced the refuted pure-width swap (spread >= 5%). New best (previous round 11.6784); 5 new code hash(es), 2 reused.
research_activity.question: Round 4: which measured candidate behaviour should the next rule keep, and which refuted shape must it avoid?
